plain.li: [spark:loss] We buried one of ours this week. I'm going to save the next ten, or know the reason why.
[spark:downed] Someone pulled me back from the edge once. I want to do that for ten people. Then I'll call it even.
[spark:Council_Ail_PulledThrough] I pulled one through this week, and I want that feeling again. Ten lives. That's the goal.
[spark:Council_Health_LostPatient] I lost a patient this week. The only answer I have is to get better, and save the next ones.
[inherited] {NAME} kept count of every life {NAME} saved. I've started a count of my own.
Ten people walking around who wouldn't be without me. That's what I want to be able to say.
[lowtech] The old healers said a healer earns the name with the tenth life. I mean to earn it.

warm.li: Ten people. Ten families who don't have to bury anyone. I can do that.

gloomy.li: People die out here all the time. I'd like ten of them not to.

cold.li: Ten successful outcomes. A reasonable measure of competence.

plain.li: Ten. Ten people I pulled back. I wrote their names on the infirmary wall, small, where only I'll notice.
That's ten lives. I didn't think I'd feel this proud of a number.

warm.li: Ten people are still here who might not have been. I've thanked every one of them for letting me help.

gloomy.li: Ten saved. I still count the ones I lost, too.

plain.li: [spark:birth] A child was born here, and I want to be the one who catches the next ones. Five, to start.
[spark:Council_Health_DeliveredBaby] I delivered a baby, and it was the best thing my hands have ever done. I want to do it again.
Every colony needs someone who knows what to do when the baby comes. I want that to be me, five times over.
[lowtech] My grandmother brought half a village into the world. I'd like to bring five into this one.

warm.li: To be the first to hold someone, five times. I can't think of anything better.

cheerful.li: Five babies! I'm already practicing my calm voice.

cold.li: Births will keep coming. Someone should become reliable at them. Five deliveries.

plain.li: Five babies delivered. Five children running around here who came into the world through my hands.

warm.li: Five little ones. I remember every first cry.

blunt.li: Five delivered. All alive. Good work.
